prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Preset Customization Fallback Flow: Add an instant preset photo customizer split screen with instant rendering to avoid generation errors. (why: 3 support messages report custom pet photo generation stalling or producing incorrect visuals during upload.)
1: [home, wait_info] Interactive Wait Screen Tips & Status: Display an animated mascot, interactive tip carousel, and live progress percentage while pet desktop assets assemble. (why: Waiting step takes median 201s (mean 2336s), causing users to suspect the app stalled or failed to launch.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Sync & Cloud Reassurance Warning: Add clear helper hint text explaining that signing in connects existing pets to prevent accidental account duplicate resets. (why: 8 emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in under a secondary or new account.)
3: [finish, copy] Desktop Visibility Guidance Copy Update: Update completion welcome copy to explicitly clarify desktop overlay permission and system tray controls. (why: Support receives inquiries about pets not displaying on screen or app failing to remain open after setup.)
4: [finish, layout] Interactive Desktop Controls Checklist Layout: Switch final home intro layout to a interactive checklist allowing users to try pet commands before closing setup. (why: Finish screen conversion is only 64.8% and users express confusion over how to interact with pets post-onboarding.)

scores.note: Adoption has a significant drop-off (60.9%), but building a new instant rendering fallback requires heavy UI work.
Funnel data strongly indicates severe wait times (median 201s/mean 2336s); progress indicators usually reduce drop-offs on long steps.
Strong evidence from 8 support emails, and very low cost as a hint text update.
Finish step conversion is low (64.8%); updating setup copy is cheap and addresses reported visibility confusion.
Interactive checklist directly addresses finish drop-off and post-onboarding confusion, but requires full new layout dev.
